title: 第18章 赚钱大计第19章 法治社会救了你们啊
slug: 诸天之百味人生第一千六百二十章
content_zh:
第18章赚钱大计
祝兄弟们五一节快乐，顺便求收藏，求推荐票，求投资。
※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※
为了在任务世界获得钞能力，华十二进入之前就做了不少准备。
首先电影里已经明确了故事开始的时间，也就是11年高考前六十天。
有了准确的时间，他先假定这个世界一切与现实世界相同，然后背下了三百多个股票代码。
也就是传说中的，每天一个涨停股。
然后华十二又记住了今后十几年的国际经济走势，这个比较简单，只用记住大数据和重大事件就可以了。
这是为了防止两个世界背景一样但细节有所出入，到时候他也能凭借预判经济走势，轻易发家。
最后他又背下了2011年高考前两个月，也就是四、五月份，世界足球五大联赛，一百多场比赛的比分数据。
这些材料虽然说起来不少，但实际上连一张a4纸都没有写满，他用一天时间背了下来，昨天回来的时候就已经都记录在纸上了。
让华十二感到兴奋的是，进入这个世界之后，发现这个世界真的如他设想的那般与现实世界一模一样。
这样的情况下，随便买个足彩的冷门比赛，直接买比分那种，轻轻松松都是几十倍，上百倍的赔率。
要是狠一点，买三串一的话，倍率能叠加到万倍以上，到时候眨眼之间就能实现财务自由。
可倒霉就倒霉在，刘北山这小子竟然没满十八周岁，按照法律，彩票是不允许卖给未成年人的。
当然现实中刘北山是17还是18，外表根本看不出来，说他20都有人信，买彩票应该不是问题，问题在于怎么兑奖。
一次中个几百上千万就要到彩票中心去领奖，那可是要检查身份证的。
华十二之前就在网上查过了，未成年人买彩和兑奖，都需要有监护人陪同。
天噜啦，刘北山哪里来的监护人？
他老爸抛妻弃子，母亲带着拖油瓶嫁不出去，在他十三岁那年，他妈因为相亲失败揍了他一顿，刘北山就此离家出走，那年刚十三岁。

刘北山的记忆中他曾经回去找过自己的母亲，可是他妈早已经搬家了。
华十二想找到刘北山他妈倒是不难，可这样的母亲，他怎么可能放心让其帮自己去领大奖呢。
叹了口气，想来想去都没什么可以信任的人，那就只能放弃彩票这个一夜暴富的途径，安心靠着炒股打发展战了。
半个小时后，外面传来了脚步声，紧接着门被敲响，华十二打开房门，来人是大康和赖子。
两个人见到华十二脸上的伤也不意外，一个是之前大康在电话里就听说了，二来他们三个平时替人收账，免不了与人冲突，受伤是经常的事情。
赖子一进来之后就笑道：
“小北哥你真牛逼，不声不响就把魏小五他们弄进去了，上次咱们把他弟揍了，他不是放话要弄咱们么，现在反倒被你收拾了！”
大康倒没有赖子这么没心没肺，进屋之后脸色不太好，从兜里掏出两沓钱放在桌子上：
“小北哥，这两万是我和赖子凑的，你拿着出去躲一阵子吧，等风头过去再回来，或者干脆就别回来了！”
华十二有些吃惊：“你们两哪来这么多钱？”
“你就别管了，赶紧拿着钱走吧！”
赖子在一旁道：“我从我妈那拿了五千，剩下是大康从他爸那里拿的！”
华十二知道大康老爸是开出租的，手里有点钱也是正常的。
他朝着大康挑了挑眉毛：“你就不怕老爷子打死你？”
大康装作不在意的点了一根烟，这才笑道：“哪那么容易打死，他可就我一个儿子，还指着我养老送终呢！”
华十二沉吟了一下，找了个单肩包出来，把两万块钱装在包里，这才道：
“这钱算我借的，十倍还你们！”

Chapter 18 Money Making Plan
I wish brothers a happy May Day, and by the way, please collect, recommend and invest.
※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※
In order to gain money abilities in the mission world, Hua Twelve made a lot of preparations before entering.
First of all, the movie has made it clear when the story begins, which is sixty days before the 2011 college entrance examination.
With the accurate time, he first assumed that everything in this world was the same as the real world, and then memorized more than 300 stock codes.
That is, as the legend goes, there is one daily limit stock.
Then Hua Twelve memorized the international economic trends in the next ten years. This is relatively simple, just remember big data and major events.
This is to prevent the two worlds from having the same background but different details, so that he can easily make a fortune by predicting economic trends.
Finally, he memorized the score data of more than 100 games in the five major world football leagues in April and May, two months before the college entrance examination in 2011.
Although these materials sounded like a lot, in fact they didn't even fill up an A4 paper. He memorized them all in one day, and when he came back yesterday, he had already recorded them all on paper.
What makes Hua Twelve excited is that after entering this world, he found that this world is exactly the same as the real world as he imagined.
Under such circumstances, if you buy any unpopular football lottery game or just buy the score, you can easily get dozens or hundreds of times the odds.
If you are more ruthless and buy three in a string, the multiplier can be superimposed to more than 10,000 times, and you will be able to achieve financial freedom in the blink of an eye.
But unfortunately, Liu Beishan is under the age of 18. According to the law, lottery tickets are not allowed to be sold to minors.
Of course, in reality, whether Liu Beishan is 17 or 18, it is impossible to tell from his appearance. Some people believe that he is 20. Buying lottery tickets should not be a problem. The problem is how to redeem the prize.
If you win hundreds or tens of millions at a time, you have to go to the lottery center to claim your prize, and your ID card will be checked.
Hua Twelve had checked online before. Minors need to be accompanied by a guardian when buying lottery tickets and redeeming prizes.
Damn it, where did Liu Beishan come from as a guardian?
His father abandoned his wife and son, and his mother couldn't get married because she was a dragster. When he was thirteen years old, his mother beat him up because of a failed blind date, and Liu Beishan ran away from home. He was just thirteen years old that year.
In Liu Beishan's memory, he once went back to find his mother, but his mother had already moved away.
It would not be difficult for Hua Twelve to find Liu Beishan's mother, but with such a mother, how could he trust her to help him receive the grand prize?
I sighed, thinking about it, there was no one I could trust, so I had to give up the lottery as a way to get rich overnight, and rely on stock trading to develop.
Half an hour later, there were footsteps outside, and then there was a knock on the door. Hua Twelve opened the door, and it was Dakang and Lai Zi who came.
The two of them were not surprised to see the injuries on Hua Twelve's face. One was because Dakang had heard about it on the phone before. Secondly, the three of them usually collected bills for others, so conflicts with others were unavoidable, and injuries were common.
As soon as Laizi came in, he smiled and said:
"Brother Xiao Bei, you are so awesome. You got Wei Xiaowu and the others in without saying a word. Last time we beat up his brother. Didn't he promise to get us? But now you have taken care of him!"
Dakang was not as heartless as Laizi. After entering the room, his face was not very good. He took out two wads of money from his pocket and put them on the table:
"Brother Xiao Bei, Lai Zi and I scraped together the 20,000 yuan. You can take it and hide for a while, then come back when the limelight passes, or don't come back at all!"
Hua Twelve was a little surprised: "Where did you two get so much money?"
"Just leave it alone, just take the money and leave!"
Lai Zi said at the side: "I took five thousand from my mother, and the rest was Dakang's from his father.Got it from inside! "
Hua Twelve knew that Dakang's father drove a taxi, so it was normal for him to have some money.
He raised his eyebrows at Dakang: "Aren't you afraid that the old man will beat you to death? "
Dakang pretended not to care and lit a cigarette, then smiled and said: "It's so easy to beat him to death, he is my only son, and he wants me to take care of him until he is old! "
Hua Twelve pondered for a moment, found a shoulder bag, put 20,000 yuan in it, and then said:
"I borrowed this money and will pay you back ten times! "
